'''Churr''' was a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] world near [[Quellor/Legends|Quellor]]. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] suffered major losses on Churr.<ref name="FDCR" />
